featured_reviews.name: Akshat Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Best school for students to learn,all the facilities provided by the school and the school system are the best. Teachers are very very very helpful kind and understanding towards students and parents equally. transport facility is good too, the school has computer lab, science lab, diy rooms,music rooms, theater rooms so that students can also learn physical science like chemistry and enjoy all activities like acting music and learn how to do art and craft carpentry and many more things with experience of 5 whole years this school my child loves all the things regarding it
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to know that your child is having such a positive learning experience with us. Your kind words about our facilities, teachers, and overall environment truly mean a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We’re glad you value our teachers, facilities, and activities, and we’ll work on improving communication, workload balance, and individual attention.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Sapkal
featured_reviews.review_text: Sir, today I came to the school for my brother’s son’s admission. I observed one thing — gas cylinders are being used in the open space in front of Gate No. 2. Generally, this is not allowed. So what about the security and safety of our children?
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Shubham, thank you for bringing this to our attention. We sincerely apologize for any concern this may have caused. The safety and security of our students remain our top priority, and we have shared your feedback with the concerned team for review. Kindly share your contact details at escalations@orchids.edu.in so that our team can get in touch with you and gather further details to address this appropriately.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello everyone
My daughter is studying in orchids international in grade 8

I am impressed with the dedication and commitment shown by Orchids International School towards providing holistic education. The school not only focuses on academic excellence but also nurtures creativity, critical thinking, and overall personality development in students

The school’s emphasis on values and life skills ensures that students are well-prepared for the future. The environment is safe, inclusive, and encouraging — making it a place where children are happy to come every day.

Overall, Orchids International School has exceeded expectations in building a strong foundation for students both academically and personally. I sincerely thank the management, teachers, and staff for their hard work and dedication.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your positive experience with us. We appreciate your feedback and will continue to strive for excellence in education.

featured_reviews.name: Million Bags
featured_reviews.review_text: This school is a remarkable place where every student is encouraged to excel and grow. The dedication and passion of the teachers create an inspiring and motivating learning environment. I appreciate how the school embraces creativity, critical thinking, and innovation alongside traditional academics. The friendly atmosphere and numerous extracurricular activities help all students develop their unique skills and confidence. Being part of this school has been an incredible experience that has shaped me into a better learner and person. I am proud to be a member of such a supportive and nurturing community."
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your heartfelt feedback! We’re delighted to know you’ve had such a positive experience and that the school’s environment has helped you grow with confidence and creativity.

featured_reviews.name: Nabila Sid
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely impressed with the quality of education and holistic development offered at this school. The teachers are not only knowledgeable and well-trained, but also genuinely care about each student’s progress and well-being. The curriculum strikes a perfect balance between academics and extracurricular activities, ensuring that children grow into confident, well-rounded individuals. The school infrastructure is modern and safe, and the management is transparent, approachable, and responsive. The leaders and faculty is very good and cooperative.Every little things are resolved in no time.
My child looks forward to going to school every day, which is the best reflection of a nurturing and engaging learning environment. I highly recommend this school to any parent looking for academic excellence combined with personal growth.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the perfect rating!

featured_reviews.name: Million bags Manufacturering
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a Grade 9 parent, I'm very satisfied with the Social Studies (SST) Department at Orchids International School, PalaGaly.
The department goes beyond rote memorization, making history, civics, and geography relevant and engaging. The teachers employ excellent teaching methods that encourage critical analysis and an understanding of current global affairs. This approach is crucial for high school students. We appreciate how they link the Grade 9 curriculum to real-world context, significantly boosting my child's perspective and analytical thinking skills. The SST department provides a truly enriching and essential academic experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your thoughtful feedback! We’re delighted to know your child is enjoying the engaging and analytical approach of our SST Department. Your appreciation truly motivates our teachers.
